name: Long²RAG
description: Long²RAG is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' capabilities in handling long-context retrieval and generating long-form responses that effectively utilize retrieved information. It includes 280 questions across 10 domains and 8 question categories, each paired with multiple long retrieved documents. The Key Point Recall (KPR) metric assesses how well models incorporate key points from retrieved documents into their generated answers.
reputation: A newer long-context RAG benchmark that is gaining attention in the LLM evaluation community, but it is not yet as widely established as older retrieval benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on long-context retrieval and long-form generation; introduces a new metric (KPR) for nuanced evaluation.
